description: Query actual lead records by an instance-supported filter_type and up to 300 filter_values. Read describe_lead_fields.searchable_fields first to discover valid standard and custom filter types. ALWAYS writes the matching leads to output_tsv_path, never inline. Pages internally across Marketo's own 300-per-call vendor ceiling (fixed server-side, no query-side parameter to raise) up to the effective row limit -- no next_page_token or continuation parameter exists on this verb. Defaults to 500 to avoid exhausting vendor rate limits and disk, and to discourage pulling all records for client-side filtering a vendor query should do instead. To fetch more, pass acknowledge_default_limit_override=true together with an explicit row_limit (up to 5,000) -- both required together, refused rather than clamped above 5,000. Beyond the hard cap there is no resumption: re-invoke with a narrower filter_values slice (e.g. a 45,000-lead job needs several non-overlapping calls, ~17 internal vendor calls each) -- check get_api_usage first if the daily quota is a concern for a large pull. Optional fields restricts returned columns -- prefer requesting stable ID and status fields over email, phone, or address fields when the goal is validation rather than a task that genuinely needs them.
embedding_description: Fetch Marketo lead records to a workspace TSV by matching an instance-supported field against up to 300 values. Pages internally past Marketo's 300-per-call ceiling, up to 5,000 with an acknowledged override, 500 by default. Returns path, columns, row count, and a truncation flag. Beyond the cap, re-invoke with a narrower filter. Prefer stable ID fields over PII for validation reads.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Marketo leads exported to a workspace TSV
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with path (the written .tsv file in the operator's workspace), columns, row_count, and truncated (true when row_count hit the effective limit -- more leads may exist, and the vendor's own per-call ceiling means this happened across several internal calls the caller never sees).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the export: the written path, row_count, and a few lead field names. If truncated is true, say the pull is INCOMPLETE and point to a higher acknowledged row_limit (up to 5,000) or, beyond that, a narrower filter_values slice re-invoked separately. Warn about cumulative API-quota cost for a large pull; suggest get_api_usage first.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Query leads by filter from the configured Marketo instance and write them to a tab-separated file in the operator's workspace, up to an acknowledged override ceiling.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: missing filter_type/filter_values/output_tsv_path, more than 300 filter_values, its parent directory does not exist, Marketo rejected a filter_type that is not searchable on this instance, acknowledge_default_limit_override and row_limit were not given together, or row_limit exceeded the 5,000 hard cap. marketo.export_path_refused: the path is not absolute, not a .tsv, or not contained under any operator-configured export_allowed_roots entry (an empty export_allowed_roots refuses every export by default). marketo.object_not_found: no leads matched the filter (Marketo code 702). marketo.auth_failed: OAuth credentials rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks Read-Only/Read-Write Person. marketo.partition_access_denied: the API user isn't assigned to the workspace/partition these leads live in. marketo.rate_limited: API rate limit exceeded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.invalid_params: read describe_lead_fields.searchable_fields and use an exact returned field name; if it is null (the instance's describe response omits the field), fall back to a well-known standard filter_type such as id or email rather than guessing. For the override pair, pass BOTH acknowledge_default_limit_override=true and an explicit row_limit, or neither (for the 500-lead default); a row_limit above 5,000 is refused outright, not clamped. marketo.export_path_refused: pass an ABSOLUTE path ending in .tsv under a configured workspace root; if export_allowed_roots is empty, add the operator's export directory to the marketo_plugin config and reload it. marketo.object_not_found: confirm the filter_type/filter_values actually match a lead. marketo.rate_limited: retry after a short delay. marketo.auth_failed: ask the operator to check the OAuth client_id/client_secret. marketo.permission_denied / marketo.partition_access_denied: run check_setup to see the exact gap and which admin screen fixes it.
